#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << modPow(p, p - 1) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<int> parent(p);
    iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    
    function<int(int)> find = [&](int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    };
    
    auto merge = [&](int a, int b) {
        a = find(a); b = find(b);
        if (a == b) return;
        parent[b] = a;
    };
    
    int components = p - (k > 1);
    
    for (long long i = 1; i < p; i++) {
        merge(static_cast<int>(i), static_cast<int>((i * k) % p));
    }
    
    // Count connected components
    unordered_set<int> roots;
    for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
        roots.insert(find(i));
    }
    
    cout << modPow(p, static_cast<long long>(roots.size())) << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}

        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exponent /= 2;
